basic_info.description: Perched high above San Francisco's iconic Embarcadero, this elegant 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence at Bridgeview offers stunning views of the Bay and Bay Bridge from every room. This spacious home features a sunlit open living and dining area, a chef's kitchen with gas range and stainless steel appliances, and a private balconyperfect for morning coffee or sunset unwinding. The generous primary suite includes custom closets, while the second bedroom provides ideal flexibility for guests or a home office. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, one-car parking, and assigned storage. Residents enjoy resort-style amenities including a fitness center, heated pool, spa, BBQ terrace, and 24/7 conciergeall within a well-maintained building. Located in the heart of South Beach, you're just steps from the Embarcadero waterfront, Oracle Park, Chase Center, and some of San Francisco's finest restaurants and entertainment. With convenient access to the Financial District, Ferry Building, and Silicon Valley commute routes, this home truly offers the best of city living. Welcome to your perfect urban retreat!
